scan_linter_check.description:
Flags database queries (new GlideRecord, GlideRecordSecure, GlideAggregate or GlideQuery) in Business Rules whose When is display (stored as before_display). Display rules run every time a form is opened, so their queries add to every form load.
Replaces the legacy check "Y1- Display Business Rules Executing GlideRecord Queries" (priority 2).
scan_linter_check.name: SN-BR-003: Display Business Rule runs queries
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Keep display Business Rules to setting g_scratchpad from data already on current. Move lookups to an asynchronous GlideAjax call made by a client script only when the data is needed, or cache the result.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A display Business Rule creates a GlideRecord, GlideAggregate or GlideQuery.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-BR-003: Display Business Rule runs queries
